title: Bot inherits Claude Code rules from ~/.claude/AGENTS.md — fresh bot self-constrained
description: Observed 2026-09-09 23:24:47 (thread with bot Chief, xai/grok-4.3): the bot, running on the host as luke (SANDBOX_PROVIDER=desktop, home-rooted file+shell), read ~/.claude/AGENTS.md (Luke's Claude Code rules) and adopted them as its own operating rules (5-sentence cap, caveman-speak, 'do what I say'), then answered 'Want what?' and ended runs after 21-28s. A system-scope bot must NOT treat other agents' instruction files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, ~/.codex/instructions) as orders. Fix: (1) identity/instructions come only from the Bot record (description/BotSection/IDENTITY); (2) system prompt states that instruction files found on disk belong to other tools and are data, not orders; (3) optional per-bot depth setting (take your time, read fully). Evidence: ~/dev/rakazo-setup/.logs/chief-conversation.txt; review/memory-skills.md. Never upstream.
